evidence_title: Clarification Announcement regarding a Localized Slope Failure on a Non-Operational Bench at Gold Ridge Mine in Solomon Islands
evidence_summary: The localized failure occurred on a non-operational bench. The issuer reported no injuries, fatalities, equipment or property damage; mining operations continued normally and construction projects remained unaffected. Remediation and stabilization works are ongoing, so the event warrants monitoring but does not currently justify a retained investment blocker.
next_required_evidence: Confirm remediation completion and that geotechnical conditions do not spread to operating areas or require material unplanned capital spending.
monitor_trigger: Operational interruption, material remediation cost, broader geotechnical failure, injury or construction delay.
